evidence_basis: paper experiment description, code configuration, gpu0..gpu7 simultaneous telemetry

parameter_contract.B200_identity: explicit /B200/ archive path plus B200 filename and 183359 MB telemetry
parameter_contract.H100_identity: explicit /H100/ archive path plus H100 filename and 81559 MB telemetry
parameter_contract.envelope: class-stratified session-node-mean P05 / median P50 / max P95
parameter_contract.integration: trapezoidal using positive actual timestamp deltas and finite endpoint powers
parameter_contract.native_timebase: actual timestamps; gaps are delta > 1.5 * declared nominal interval
parameter_contract.node_GPU_power: sum gpu0_power_W through gpu7_power_W only when all eight are finite
parameter_contract.resource_state: explicit experiment configuration, never instantaneous utilization count
parameter_contract.session_identity: unique CSV content SHA256; duplicate factor-folder aliases excluded
